title: Authentic Laos Tapioca Pudding with Bananas
hookLine: Global-inspired authentic laos tapioca pudding with bananas with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: In a bowl of warm water, add tapioca pearls and allow them to soak for 20 minutes. Prepare bananas by peeling them and cutting them into ½ inch slices. Set the slices aside. Incorporate {m53425_1}, {m53425_2}, {m53425_3}, and {m53425_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure warm water first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: On a stove, pour in 4 cups of water and bring it to a boil. Add in the banana slices. After 20 minutes, drain the tapioca pearls in cold water to allow the pearls to separate from each other.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53425_5}, {m53425_6}, {m53425_7}, and {m53425_8} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Add the tapioca pearls into the the pot. Allow to simmer for 3 minutes or until the tapioca pearls turn clear. Next, add in sugar and pour in the coconut cream. Stir the ingredients gently for 3 minutes to incorporate the flavors.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
